title: Verdict audit
description: The Verifier's mechanical audit of a verdict (final-plan.md Investigator verdict checks; §3.4 'Verifier evidence audit'; §7.3 substitution check). Runs on every verdict: cited evidence must replay, refutation duty must be present (a verdict with no discarded alternatives fails), and gate-class CONFIRMED verdicts require the cross-family falsification pass. Recursive semantic review of verdicts is forbidden — this audit checks evidence, never judgment.

citation.description: The cited command, path:line, or search the verdict rests on

refutation_duty_present.description: The verdict names its two strongest discarded alternatives with citations; false fails the audit

cross_family.description: Copied from the dispatch record, never from the verdict text

gate_class.description: Whether this verdict authorizes Principal-tier, data, or security work

falsification_run.description: Required content when gate_class is true and the verdict is a CONFIRMED-grade authorization; absent otherwise

note.description: UNAVAILABLE downgrades the verdict to LIKELY; it cannot authorize gate-class work

issued_against_substituted_output.description: P15 check: whether the audited verdict was issued against output later found to be served by a substituted model
